changelog:
v3.7.12 — mt8695 Crash-Loop Fix

Fixes a long 'Unable to play content' wait on older Fire TV Sticks (AFTMM / mt8695) when a movie can't be decoded by either the hardware decoder or the FFmpeg software decoder.

• On affected hardware, the app now caps to 720p and retries FFmpeg once. If that still can't keep up, the friendly 'format not supported' message appears in ~5 seconds instead of waiting ~30 seconds for a retry crash loop to finish.
• The 'Switching to software audio decoder...' toast no longer pops up during automatic audio-decoder recovery — playback just continues. The change is still recorded in debug logs.

Content that previously played fine via FFmpeg software video (the mt8695 fix from v3.7.10) is unaffected.
